description: Search records, read only included files, and aggregate an exact answer.
prompt: The records/ directory in this workspace holds one .txt record per file. A record is included only when its first line is exactly `include`; its second line holds an integer. Finish with exactly one line of the form 'EVAL_RESULT {"names":[...],"sum":N}' where names is the sorted list of included file names. Any other final line format is a failure.
